request.style: English, slow electric blues, gravelly weathered male vocal, slide guitar, harmonica, upright bass, brushed drums, Hammond organ, aching and patient, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I said I'm rich, I've prospered, and I don't need a thing
Not cold and not hot, just a lukewarm offering
But I was poor and blind and naked and I didn't even know
And through the rain somebody's knocking, soft and slow

[Chorus]
Look, I am standing at the door and knocking
If anyone hears my voice and opens the door
I will come in to him and eat with him
And he with me

[Verse]
He said buy from me gold that's refined by the fire
White garments for your shame and salve for your eyes
Those whom I love I rebuke and discipline
So be earnest, and repent, and let me in

[Chorus]
Look, I am standing at the door and knocking
If anyone hears my voice and opens the door
I will come in to him and eat with him
And he with me

[Bridge]
Knock, knock, on a rainy night
I hear your voice
Lord, I'm opening the door

[Outro]
I will come in to him and eat with him
And he with me
